programme.title: The Jennings vs Alzheimer's
programme.desc: The documentary presents the history of the Jennings family, thanks to which it was possible to confirm the heredity of Alzheimer's disease.It all started with research conducted by the University College in London.In 1986, Professor John Hardy launched a newsletter that sought to collect reports from families with two or more cases of Alzheimer's disease.The team received many messages, but it was the one from Carol Jennings that caught their attention.In the letter, the woman described in detail the stories of her loved ones - her father, brother and sister.Each of them started showing symptoms after the age of 50.Thanks to the information provided, scientists managed to make a breakthrough in the field.

programme.desc: The creators of the series go on a train journey to various places around the world.During each expedition, they meet people who live in specific areas or work on the most unique railway routes.They will also discover the wonders of nature that can be admired from the train windows.They will talk to engineers responsible for maintaining the lines and historians who will talk about the circumstances of their construction and the difficulties their builders faced.Viewers will be able to admire the landscapes of Norway, New Zealand, Canada, Switzerland, Wales and Spain.

programme.title: Alexander Armstrong in Sri Lanka
programme.desc: After the economic crisis that occurred in 2022, Sri Lanka is opening up to tourists again.As a result of the pandemic and the suspension of tourist traffic, the country suffered economically.There were riots, including:storming the president's house by 700,000 citizens.Sri Lanka, which until 1972 was called Ceylon, is visited by actor and comedian Alexander Armstrong.He admires the charms of a diverse and multicultural country, which is no stranger to civil wars and natural disasters.He sees ritual exorcisms and is skilled in the ancient martial art of Angampora.He also takes an oil bath and tries to keep up with the Sri Lankan fishermen who fish on stilts.
